data.text: Exception handling manages runtime errors gracefully using try-catch-finally blocks, preventing application crashes and enabling error recovery.
Exceptions represent errors that occur during execution. try block contains code that might throw. catch block handles specific exceptions. finally block always executes for cleanup.
